counterfactual_rationale: Record says WNA16 LoRA could not select the correct modular kernel after refactoring. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says SGLang RMSNorm used a different cast and multiply order from HF, compounding ULP differences into MMLU accuracy loss. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says the ROCm FP8 per-token-group quant kernel used max 224 on gfx95x where e4m3fn max is 448. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
Record only has the subject Fix nvfp4 online scale with pcg and an empty body, so it lacks enough evidence for kernel-correctness coding.

Record says GemmaRMSNorm reassigned a buffer so CUDA graph capture kept using stale weights and produced logp differences. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says FlashMLA sparse accuracy needed precise topk_length masking and zero-initialized BF16 head padding. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says ROCm non-MLA models failed to load because MLAAttention eagerly imported flash_attn. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says NPU MTP unquant settings for the draft model incorrectly affected the main model and caused a server error. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says unsorted MoE top-k experts could replace a non-minimal expert with the shared expert, altering layer behavior. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says a torch binding typo caused CUTLASS block-FP8 support to call the wrong function, leading to random or empty output on CUDA 12.4 Ada. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says TRTLLM MHA FP8 KV cache missed Q and K/V scale handoff, so attention BMM scales were wrong. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record includes CUDA graph runner fixes for stale padded-token counts, MoE padded-row routing, and stale prefill input embeddings. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record includes a Qwen MoE double-memory-consumption bug and NPU GroupedMatmul layout conversion. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says uninitialized garbage expert IDs in all-to-all padding made the downstream TRTLLM MoE kernel process invalid entries and produce NaN. A sanitizer, memcheck, initcheck, or racecheck run on the described path would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says the AMD aiter ASM path crashed with cannot get heuristic kernel after a gluon-related regression. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says BF16 flashinfer_trtllm MoE crashed in nightly B200 CI because StandardCombineInput was not imported. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says DSV4 JIT kernels failed to build under hipcc because CUDA-only device-attribute enums were used in a non-hipified JIT path. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
